live_snapshot_note: Case files, costs and active request stores are read sequentially while execution may continue; their snapshots can differ slightly during this compilation interval.

scores.aggregation: Mean over planned query cohort only when complete; available-only mean and missing bounds otherwise; datasets also reported separately.

union20.cost_note: Logical usage includes exact cache replays; actual payments and unresolved reservations are reported by the runner budget ledger.

budget.meaning: Known costs are returned-usage estimates recorded by the budget ledger; unknown liabilities remain reserved. Cache replays do not add ledger charges.

requests.scope: All task method stores, including currently running cases and both immutable retry rounds; these are experiment-wide totals rather than a pilot-only payment allocation.
